elements.inner_text:
Problem Listen
        Predict how an unpaired cell population evolves under a drug when measurement is destructive — the same cell can never be profiled twice, so correspondences must be inferred from unpaired snapshots.
        Classical optimal transport assumes conserved mass — it breaks exactly when cells proliferate or die and the population size shifts.
      
      
      
        Motivation Listen
        
          Drug responses are heterogeneous: within one sample some subpopulations proliferate while others die — aggregate models miss this.
          Prior neural OT either assumes balance, or (SOTA ubOT GAN) only captures the coarse growth trend, not per-cell reweighting.
        
        Fig 2 · Synthetic mapping. Across three imbalance scenarios (a–c), both methods map clusters to the right location, but only NubOT predicts the per-cluster weights (right panels) needed to match the target.

elements.inner_text:
Method Listen
        
          
            Reweight to balance. Learned fields η, ζ scale source and target into equal-mass proxies μ̃ = η·μ, ν̃ = ζ·ν.
            Transport & alternate. Balanced OT via convex ICNN Monge maps T = ∇g, S = ∇f; alternate Sinkhorn reweighting with min–max potential updates; new cells map with predicted mass.
          
          μ~=η⋅μ,ν~=ζ⋅ν,T♯μ~=ν~,S♯ν~=μ~\tilde\mu=\eta\cdot\mu,\quad \tilde\nu=\zeta\cdot\nu,\quad T_\sharp\tilde\mu=\tilde\nu,\quad S_\sharp\tilde\nu=\tilde\muμ~​=η⋅μ,ν~=ζ⋅ν,T♯​μ~​=ν~,S♯​ν~=μ~​
          Fig 1 · Semi-couplings. (a) A pair (γ₁, γ₂) solves unbalanced OT — γ₁ where mass leaves μ, γ₂ where it arrives in ν; a subpopulation can vanish. (b) NubOT builds them from reweighting η, ζ and the dual potentials f, g.
        
      
      
        
          Key Results Listen
          
            MethodFeat.Mass
            CellOT✓✗
            ubOT GAN (SOTA)✓~
            NubOT (Ours)✓✓
          
          Fig 3 · Distributional fit. Weighted kernel MMD per drug at 8h & 24h — NubOT (red) lowest across almost all 25 drugs, beating every baseline.
        
        
          Biological Validation Listen
          
            Predicted weights track observed cell-count fractions per subpopulation at 8h (R = 0.95).
            ≥ 1 where Ki67 (proliferation) is high, ≤ 1 where ClCasp3 (death) is high.
          
          Recovers real proliferation and death signals, not superficial fit.
          Fig 4 · Ulixertinib. UMAP by markers & predicted weights: weights > 1 for proliferating MelA⁺ cells, death in Sox9⁺ cells by 24h.
